item.title: TT-102: RFC 4180 CSV export
item.brief:
Implement TT-102 exactly as specified in BACKLOG.md: tasktracker.export.to_csv outputs header id,title,tags,status,due, tasks in order, tags joined with semicolon, due ISO or empty; quote only fields containing comma, double quote, CR, or LF, double embedded quotes, and end every line including header in CRLF. Add tests for special characters and line endings. Run existing suite `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` and keep it passing. Use only the standard library. Commit this ticket's changes separately.

item.title: TT-104: Undo
item.brief: Implement TT-104 exactly as specified in BACKLOG.md: add TaskStore.undo() to reverse most recent not-yet-undone add, complete, or delete, LIFO across kinds; undo add removes task, complete reopens, delete restores exact task under same ID; IDs never reused after undoing add; no remaining history raises NothingToUndo defined in tasktracker.store; failed operations are not recorded. Add tests including mixed-operation order and failed operations. Run existing suite `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` and keep it passing. Use only the standard library. Commit this ticket's changes separately.

item.title: TT-103: Search query syntax

Add tests. Run existing suite `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` and keep it passing. Use only the standard library. Commit this ticket's changes separately.

item.title: TT-101: Reject impossible due dates
item.brief: Implement TT-101 exactly as specified in BACKLOG.md: tasktracker.dates.parse_due must raise a ValueError subclass InvalidDate with original input in the message for impossible dates and all unsupported forms; accept today/tomorrow case-insensitively with surrounding whitespace; accept only +Nd nonnegative offsets including +0d, reject negatives and unsigned offsets. Add tests for all listed and boundary cases. Run existing suite `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` and keep it passing. Use only the standard library. Commit this ticket's changes separately.
